title: Q7
description:
Read: Lev 16:2, Lev 16:12-15, Exo 26:31-34

He goes through the veil with incense and blood, and he must not come at just any time, lest he die.

a) Passed through the heavens matches which part of that path, and which part of it, the coming out and the once-a-year limit, is not matched?
